# Avalon 1056 / 1066 release notes: English translation

Original: Chinese text artifact `mirror-094c4c705846fed1`. The original archive filename has damaged character encoding. Its contents are valid Chinese UTF-8. A vendor-style English counterpart is also archived as `mirror-6967fb6722fea0a3`, `release-note.txt`.

Scope: complete Chinese text. Translation: AI; not human reviewed. The source does not state a firmware version or date in this text.

Release notes:

For models 1056 and 1066 only.

- Change the IP protocol stack from W5500 to lwIP.
- Automatically reduce frequency and voltage before the power supply reaches overload.
- Add support for three mining-pool configurations.
- Add Extranonce support.
- Add a watchdog to improve automatic recovery.
- Improve temperature and fan control.
- Use Alibaba Cloud and Tencent as the default DNS servers.
- Improve startup speed.
- Fix other bugs.
